# `srs relation`

```text
Relation commands

Usage: srs relation [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  list          List relations
  neighbours    List an instance's relation neighbours, paged (id, label, type — never the record)
  create        Create a relation (reads JSON from stdin)
  get           Get a relation by ID
  delete        Delete a relation by ID
  chain-insert  Insert an instance into a `precedes` chain, chain-local (reads JSON from stdin: `{ "instanceId", "afterId" | "beforeId" }`, srs-rust#1124)
  chain-remove  Remove an instance from its `precedes` chain, reconnecting its neighbours (reads JSON from stdin: `{ "instanceId" }`, srs-rust#1124)
  chain-move    Move an instance to a new position in a `precedes` chain, chain-local, in one batch (reads JSON from stdin: `{ "instanceId", "afterId" | "beforeId" }`, srs-rust#1124)
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --repo <REPO>
          Repository path (defaults to auto-detect from current directory)

      --format <FORMAT>
          Output format

          Possible values:
          - json: JSON output (default)
          - yaml: YAML output
          - text: Human-readable text output (planned, currently returns diagnostic)
          
          [default: json]

      --store <STORE>
          Storage backend override. By default the backend is inferred from the repository location
          
          [possible values: file, json]

      --pretty
          Pretty-print JSON output (no effect on text format)

      --container <CONTAINER_ID>
          Container scope: constrains list/create/delete to this container's membership; on `context record` it adds the record's arrangement subtree in this container

      --actor <ACTOR>
          Session actor for everything this invocation creates (RFC-046 `createdBy`): JSON `{"kind":"human|ai","id":"<non-empty>","name":"<optional>"}`. Defaults to the `SRS_ACTOR` environment variable; with neither, creations are unattributed. Host configuration only — a request payload never carries it. An invalid value refuses every creating command (`actor-invalid`); a corpus below dataModelRevision 9 refuses an actor session (`revision-too-old`) until `repo apply-migration --id rfc046-actor-provenance`. A `.srsj` migrated in memory on open refuses every write first (`migration-required-before-write`) until its migrations are applied

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

## `srs relation neighbours`

```text
List an instance's relation neighbours, paged (id, label, type — never the record)

Usage: srs relation neighbours [OPTIONS] <ID>

Arguments:
  <ID>
          Instance ID (Record or Note)

Options:
      --repo <REPO>
          Repository path (defaults to auto-detect from current directory)

      --type <RELATION_TYPE>
          Only edges of this relation type

      --direction <DIRECTION>
          Only edges in this direction relative to the instance: out | in (default: both)

      --format <FORMAT>
          Output format

          Possible values:
          - json: JSON output (default)
          - yaml: YAML output
          - text: Human-readable text output (planned, currently returns diagnostic)
          
          [default: json]

      --limit <LIMIT>
          Maximum edges to return (default: all; `total` always counts every match)

      --store <STORE>
          Storage backend override. By default the backend is inferred from the repository location
          
          [possible values: file, json]

      --offset <OFFSET>
          Number of edges to skip, after the deterministic sort
          
          [default: 0]

      --pretty
          Pretty-print JSON output (no effect on text format)

      --container <CONTAINER_ID>
          Container scope: constrains list/create/delete to this container's membership; on `context record` it adds the record's arrangement subtree in this container

      --actor <ACTOR>
```
